title: Zesty Molten Argentinian Almond Empanadas
description: A vegan-friendly Argentinian dish featuring ground almonds and double-rise bread, perfect for a snack or light meal. This recipe combines malty and molten flavors with a crispy exterior.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground almonds, malt syrup, olive oil, salt, sugar, and lemon zest.
In a separate bowl, proof the yeast by mixing it with the warm water and letting it sit for 5 minutes.
Add the yeast mixture to the almond mixture and stir until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Let the dough rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until it has doubled in size.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 8 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle and place a few cubes of double-rise bread in the center.
Fold the dough over the bread and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with apple cider vinegar and bake for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
